_doc: Per-arm participant flow (started / completed / not-completed) and VERBATIM non-completion reasons, pulled from ClinicalTrials.gov v2 resultsSection.participantFlowModule for every pooled trial across all 32 live topics. DATA ONLY -- no D3 (attrition risk-of-bias) judgement is assigned in this pass; judgement is a separate fresh pass. Per the AMPLITUDE-O rule the non-completion REASON is carried verbatim and attrition is NEVER derived from started-minus-completed.
source: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 (full-record fetch; the ?fields=ResultsSection filter silently omitted the module and is not used)
